content.caption: Green check mark icon used in the WikiSkill ablation table to indicate that a component has wiki access.
content.description: The picture is a single small green check mark (tick) on a plain white background. It has no text, arrows or other elements. On the page it appears in Table 3, the ablation study of WikiSkill using Gemini-3.5-Flash. There it fills the two 'WikiSkill Components' columns, 'Inference Agent Wiki Access' and 'Skill Proposer Wiki Access'. A green check means that component has wiki access during skill evolution, while a red cross means it does not. The Inference Agent column carries a check in two configurations: the one scoring an average of 45.3 and the one scoring 60.9. The Skill Proposer column carries a check in the 60.9 configuration and in the bottom row. The bottom row scores the best average of 63.7 and is the default WikiSkill setup, in which only the Skill Proposer has wiki access.
